name: Resilience
body:
The ghoul’s touch makes the subject more vulnerable to occult powers.

Requirement: Ghoul HD 15.

Effect: The subject takes a –4 penalty to all saving throws for 1d6+1 rounds. A successful Will saving throw reduces the penalty to –2.

Improved Loss

The subject also takes a –4 penalty to its Spell Resistance, if it has one. A successful saving throw reduces this penalty as well to –2.

Gain and Loss

If the target fails its saving throw against this effect, the ghoul gains a +5 luck bonus to all saving throws for 1 minute.
